Learned counsel for the petitioners files a memo of even date, seeking leave of this Court, to withdraw the petition with liberty to file fresh petition along with the charge sheet.
2. The memo is placed on record.
In view of the memo, leave granted.
Petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for.
3. In view of disposal of the petition, pending interlocutory applications, if any, stand disposed of as they do not survive for consideration.
